messages:
sophia_sales: Quick sync re: SiennaHealth POC. They want to serve a custom Sienna-Dialog-13B fork plus a 4-bit quant variant. Requirements: p50 ~150ms, KV cache support for long convo state, and SOC2 readiness. They asked about pricing for ~100k tokens/day. Any immediate red flags to surface to legal/infra?
leo_se: @sophia_sales couple q's: model format (GGUF/HF)? tokenizer present? any custom ops?
jordan_sienna: HF weights and GGUF export both available. tokenizer.json + merges included. no custom CUDA ops in their repo. sharing artifact link shortly.
raj_infra: 4-bit generally fine but depends on quant technique. need compatibility scan. also need sample inference traces to size batching for p50 150ms.
anya_security: flagging security items: data residency, KMS, model provenance attestation. need PII review — are convos stored on our infra or their storage?
jordan_sienna: convos remain in customer's PII store; Redwood does inference. they want optional KV caching on our side (customer-owned cache keys) — ok if KMS used.
leo_se: caching is doable per-customer and keys can be encrypted with their KMS. note: cache complicates rollouts (invalidations on model switch).
sophia_sales: pricing: approx Dedicated monthly for 100k tokens/day with caching? cost delta 4-bit vs fp16?
leo_se: rough: with caching + 4-bit on an 80GB GPU pool, baseline could fit on one dedicated instance. 4-bit reduces memory & token cost — estimate 20-40% lower token cost vs fp16; bench needed for exact.
raj_infra: I'll run compatibility and perf. need model URL (gguf/hf), ~20 prompt examples, and one full convo to exercise KV cache.
sophia_sales: Jordan drop link + prompts + security contact?
jordan_sienna: link: https://s3.siennahealth.com/models/sienna-dialog-13b/weights.gguf. prompts in drive (DM'd). sec contact: elena@siennahealth.com
deploy-bot: [build] compatibility-scan queued: job_id=cs-7975312468-1 runner: dev-infer-03
leo_se: FYI some GGUF exports use attention kernels that fall back from optimized ops — if scan shows fallback p50 may increase.
anya_security: also request SOC2 report and KMS key rotation policy; note if they require HSM-backed keys.
raj_infra: bench plan: try 4-bit first with batching off for raw latency, then enable continuous batching + KV. commands:
```
redwood scan-compat --model-url https://s3.siennahealth.com/models/sienna-dialog-13b/weights.gguf --output=scan.json
redwood bench --model-path ./local/gguf --prompts ./prompts.json --mode=latency --bs=1
```
leo_se: if 4-bit fails we ask for fp16 HF tarball or try int8 conversion.
sophia_sales: timeline: compatibility + latency sketch in 48hrs? they want reserved capacity decision next week.
raj_infra: will have initial scan + perf within 36 hrs; kernel work adds time.
jordan_sienna: will provide fp16 + distilled variants on request.
anya_security: will draft security questionnaire sections once we have SOC2 + KMS details and loop legal if needed.
leo_se: recommend onboarding three artifacts: (1) fp16 HF tarball, (2) 4-bit GGUF, (3) distilled dialog-lite variant as fallback.
sophia_sales: include fallback policy in proposal. Jordan ok to request three artifacts?
jordan_sienna: yes, engineering can export those.
deploy-bot: [status] cs-7975312468-1 started on dev-infer-03 (est ~20m)
leo_se: caching note: can reduce token costs significantly for long conversations; I'll prepare an estimate once bench numbers available.
sophia_sales: thanks teamlet's reconvene after scan. I'll draft 1-page POC plan (timeline, deliverables, asks from Sienna).
raj_infra: starting scan now.
anya_security: ack, prepping security draft.
jordan_sienna: artifacts and SOC2 link shared, thanks all! :thumbsup:
